messages.subject: Schedule of Loss — supporting records for disclosure
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Grace,

To support the Schedule of Loss (£2,359,600) on disclosure, please could your finance team pull together: the alternative-supplier invoices and the premium calculation; the recall/rebuild cost records (410 units); the Line 3 downtime and lost-contribution figures (six weeks); and the remedial/inspection costs. The defendant will challenge each head, so the better our underlying documents the stronger our position — particularly on the £742k lost-production figure, which is the most exposed under clause 11.

Thanks,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
DX 138760 Cheapside | +44 (0)20 7946 0991
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
